programme.title: Hum Pyar Tumhi Se Kar Baithe
programme.desc: An upset wife leaves her husband Vikas because of his illegal activities.

programme.title: Mr. & Mrs. Khiladi
programme.desc: Raja, a carefree dreamer, is told by an astrologer that fortune awaits him. He falls for Shalu, a rich girl, but her father demands he prove himself through hard work and success.

programme.title: Kal Ki Awaz
programme.desc: When a bank chairman's son is abducted and held for ransom, DSP Ali intervenes but cannot save the child. Later, his world is turned upside down when his daughter is kidnapped.

programme.title: Sansar
programme.desc: A family faces tough times and strained relationships, but the determined leading lady steps up to bring everyone back together and heal their bonds.

programme.title: Muqabla
programme.desc: Two brothers find themselves jobs in the police department, when difference arise between them personally and professionally.

programme.title: Aitraaz
programme.desc: In a twisted legal battle, a man faces a sexual harassment lawsuit after his boss's wife claims he raped her. It's a tense showdown of truths as the jury decides.

programme.title: Gentleman
programme.desc: Twins Hari and Om have different childhoods after they are separated at birth. However, their lives intersect when Hari is mistaken for his twin and thrown in jail.

programme.title: Jaanam
programme.desc: Dhanraj, an unscrupulous builder, has an eye on the village populated by fishermen. However, complications arise when his daughter, Anjali, falls in love with Amar who stays in the same village.

programme.title: Prem Deewane
programme.desc: Radha and Manohar are crazy about each other and dream of tying the knot. Their love story is all about passion, hope, and the journey toward happily ever after.

programme.title: Khiladi
programme.desc: Raj, Neelam, and Boney fake Sheetal's kidnapping as a prank, but things go horribly wrong when she is actually murdered. Now, all clues point to them as the prime suspects in the crime.

programme.title: Pyar Jhukta Nahin
programme.desc: Preeti returns to her parents' home after facing tensions in her marriage with Ajay, seeking comfort and clarity while navigating the ups and downs of her complicated relationship.

programme.title: Henna
programme.desc: After falling into a river, an Indian man loses his memory and ends up in a Pakistani village. Welcomed by locals, his peaceful life shatters with tragedy once he remembers his past.

programme.title: China Gate
programme.desc: Ten former soldiers, court-martialed for fleeing the battlefield, rescue a village from an evil dacoit.

programme.title: Phool Bane Angaray
programme.desc: After her husband is murdered, a determined wife joins the police force, seeking justice and vengeance. She dives into a thrilling journey filled with danger and unexpected twists.

programme.title: Awarapan

programme.title: Issaq
programme.desc: In Banaras, two rival land mafia families, the Kashyaps and the Mishras, clash for power and control, leading to thrilling conflicts and unexpected twists in their relentless battle.

programme.title: Daanveer
programme.desc: After his father dies, Vijay steps up to raise his younger siblings, taking on hard duties, responsibility, and resilience to keep his family together.

programme.title: Andaz Apna Apna
programme.desc: Amir, son of a barber and Prem, son of a tailor take off to the city to marry rich Raveena Bajaj.

programme.title: Haisiyat
programme.desc: A union leader marries his employer, but subsequently gets embroiled in labor/management disputes.

programme.title: Kasam Suhaag Ki
programme.desc: A wounded serpent seeks revenge on the killers of her husband. Does she finally manage to succeed in her mission?

programme.title: Karma

programme.title: Jodidar

programme.title: Two Smiles
programme.desc: Mike gets assigned in the same group with Lucy for history class and enjoys the time studying and eating Hamburger with Lucy, who he has a crush on.

programme.title: Top of Coit Tower
programme.desc: One day, X shows up at Mike's house. X attacks Mike with Crying Man and tries to take all the Hero Books, while Mike uses Sylph to bring back Crying Man's Hero Book.

programme.title: Revolution
programme.desc: Lucy explains to Mike that Scott who created the Hero Books is her uncle and that she's collecting the Hero Books to find clues to her missing uncle.

programme.title: Villains vs Heroes
programme.desc: The battle between Dirk O's gang versus Mike and X breaks out, and with Diro O's overwhelming power, the entire city is in danger.

programme.title: Strawberry On The Air
programme.desc: Mike and Lucy become a team through Season 1. They rescue a plane crashing into the sea in front of the city and show the abilities as a new team as heroes.

programme.title: Criminals and Chameleon
programme.desc: Mike and Lucy defeat the villains who use Chameli with the ability of a chameleon to commit crimes. However, the police and citizens treat all Hero Book Readers as criminals.

programme.title: Hard-Hitting Interview
programme.desc: Tara interviews Super Awesome Man and X through Nick. Mike tries his best not to get caught by Tara. Meanwhile, Mike's group chasing Chameli runs into Christa and Timo.

programme.title: The Good, The Bad and The Jelly
programme.desc: Mike's group engages in their first battle with Christa, and they are overwhelmed by her power, even losing the Hero Book. In a moment of crisis, Mike reveals a new power, 'Comical Create'.

programme.title: Coin Robber
programme.desc: The Council of Comics, stealing the 25 Cent's Hero Book from bank robbers, gather to create Nerd-utopia at their hideout, Papa Princess's house.

programme.title: Dizzy Donut Clues
programme.desc: Mike and his friends receive information from the Justice Boosters and visit Mrs. Cubbenson. There, they encounter Papa Princess, a member of the Council of Comics, and engage in a battle.

programme.title: Special Delivery
programme.desc: Cynthia's condition gets worse, and Super Scott feels being in danger. Christa's group continues to battle in search of the Dizzy 7 Hero Books and engages in a battle with the Council of Comics.

programme.title: Get The Book
programme.desc: The Council of Comics, chasing Christa to the milk tea shop, witnesses Super Scott's abilities and engages in a battle to seize his comic book.

programme.title: Battle on the Bridge
programme.desc: Chasing after Super Scott's Hero Book through the city, the main characters finally encounter Super Scott on a giant suspension bridge.

programme.desc: Mike comes across a Hero Book, a comic book that summons a hero when the hero's name is called, and saves his friend Nick from danger using Crying Man from a comic book.

programme.desc: With Dirk O's order to steal a Hero Book, Black Knight accidentally sets a house on fire, and Mike uses Crying Man to put out the fire and saves people.
